verdict.rationale: Brave's Web Search docs describe date-based filtering, both a recency preset (Last 24 Hours, `pd`) and a custom date range (e.g. `2022-04-01to2022-07-30`), plus real-time news. The 'frequently updated index' part rests on a single vendor claim of 'fresh' results, with no stated crawl or refresh cadence and no independent check, so it is not fully covered. missing for 10: documented index update frequency or crawl cadence, the full set of recency presets beyond `pd`, independent or hands-on corroboration of result freshness.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can get fresh results with date-range and recency filters backed by a frequently updated index

citations.quote: Web Search offers powerful date-based filtering to help you find the most relevant content
Last 24 Hours (`pd`): Get the latest updates and recent content
Custom Date Range: Specify exact timeframes (e.g., `2022-04-01to2022-07-30`)
Our service crawls and indexes billions of web pages, ensuring fresh and accurate search results for your applications.
Get real-time news articles from thousands of trusted sources worldwide.
